# Recursion

> Run each step in order on Linux. Each step is one recursiond command. Read stdout.
> When the text after the arrow is a JSON object, that object is the success answer.
> doctor_report is the doctor object (generated_at and checks). snippet is the Control
> MCP snippet: TOML for codex, one JSON object for claude and cursor. The snippet is
> printed. Nothing is written into a client config.

- `recursiond doctor --json` -> doctor_report
- `recursiond provision` -> {"code":"ok"}
- `recursiond up` -> {"code":"ok","gui":"http://127.0.0.1:8765"}
- `recursiond mcp-config --client codex` -> snippet
- `recursiond mcp-config --client claude` -> snippet
- `recursiond mcp-config --client cursor` -> snippet
